story: As a shopper, I want to check out a selected product so that I can complete a purchase and see an order confirmation.
criteria: AC-01 | The cart shows each selected product with the same name and price as the inventory page.
AC-02 | Checkout cannot continue when First Name, Last Name, or Postal Code is empty; a visible field-level error is shown.
AC-03 | The checkout overview shows the item subtotal, tax, and total; total equals subtotal plus tax.
AC-04 | Finishing a valid order shows a visible order-complete confirmation.
